_help: A-17: the in-game explanations of Spellcraft (scripts/UiSpellHelp.cs). types: one plain sentence per card type, shown at the top of every card's tooltip. cards: a plain 'when to use it' line per card id (data/spellcards.json), shown under the card's own text. panel: the 'How spellcraft works' help panel (Spellcraft window > How it works): sections of a title and lines; {tokens} are filled from data/spellcards.json so the numbers always match the rules ({effectP} {statusDurP} {costP} {secCost2} {secCost3} {secCd2} {secCd3} {zoneDur} {zoneTick} {slotsBase} {slotsPer} {copiesBase} {copiesPer} {sec3Level} {maxSpells} {chainCarriers} {rankP}). firstHint: shown once per hero the first time the window is opened.
firstHint: First time here? A spell is one CARRIER card (how it is delivered) plus one EFFECT card (what it does). Add MODIFIER cards to change it, then press Forge. "How it works" at the top explains the rest.

types.carrier: CARRIER: how the spell is delivered (a bolt, a burst around you, a strike from the sky, a weapon swing). It sets the shape, range, cost, cooldown and cast time. Every section needs exactly one kind.
types.effect: EFFECT: what the spell does when it lands: its damage type and the status it inflicts (burn, chill, shock...). Every section needs exactly one kind.
types.modifier: MODIFIER: an optional card that changes the section it sits in (more damage, bigger area, extra missiles, cheaper, faster). Any number, and copies stack.

families.spell: Spell carrier: costs mana, scales with Magic and spell power.
families.martial: Martial carrier: costs stamina, scales with your weapon's damage. Needs a melee weapon in hand.
families.archery: Archery carrier: costs stamina, scales with your weapon's damage. Needs a bow.

cards.missile: The simplest carrier: aim and fire. Good first section, because whatever comes after it goes off where the bolt lands.
cards.area: Hits everything close to you (or, as a later section, around the point the spell reached). With a Time card in the same section it becomes a lingering zone.
cards.chain: Best against groups standing apart: each jump hits a little less hard.
cards.strike: Hold the key to place it, release to call it down after a short delay. Strong, but foes can walk out.
cards.trap: Place it where foes will walk. It waits, so set it before the fight.
cards.altar: A turret: it keeps attacking while you do something else.
cards.wall: Blocks a path with damage. Good in doorways and corridors.
cards.vortex: Gathers a pack into one spot: follow it with an Area or Strike section.
cards.beam: Constant damage along a line for as long as it lasts. Keep the crosshair on the foe.
cards.orbit: Damage around you while you move and fight. Good for melee heroes.
cards.enchant: Support carrier: the effect becomes a buff for you and allies instead of damage.
cards.ward: Defensive carrier: a shield on you; the effect decides its extra protection.
cards.slash: A weapon swing with the effect's damage type on it. Short cooldown, stamina cost.
cards.whirl: Hits all around you several times. Stand in the middle of the pack.
cards.leap: A gap closer: hold to aim, release to jump there and slam.
cards.lunge: A straight dash that hits everything along the line.
cards.quake: Waves of damage around you, good for knocking a crowd about.
cards.blades: Blades circle you for a while and cut whatever comes close.
cards.glaive: Hits on the way out and again on the way back.
cards.volley: Several arrows in a fan: point blank, all of them hit one foe.
cards.rain: Hold to aim, release: arrows fall on the circle for a few seconds.
cards.rebound: One arrow, several foes: it bounces between them.
cards.snare: A trap that holds the first foe to step on it.
cards.fire: Burning foes take fire damage every second. Good all-round damage.
cards.frost: Chilled foes move and attack slower; the third chill freezes them solid.
cards.storm: Shocked foes take more damage from everything, so open with it.
cards.venom: Poison stacks: weak at first, deadly on long fights and bosses.
cards.holy: Judged foes take more damage; strong against the Shadow realm's creatures.
cards.shadow: Weakened foes hit you less hard. A defensive kind of damage.
cards.steel: Plain physical damage with a chance to bleed. Works on any weapon carrier.
cards.stone: Sunders armor (physical hits after it do more) and can root foes in place.
cards.life: Heals you as it harms. On an Enchant or Ward it becomes healing over time.
cards.time: Longer burns, chills and buffs. In a section with an Area carrier it turns the burst into a zone that stays and repeats.
cards.protection: A small heal every cast: good on a spell you use all the time.
cards.spray: More projectiles or bursts for a little less damage each.
cards.ricochet: Turns a single-target hit into a small chain.
cards.pierce: Line up your foes and hit them all.
cards.force: Control: pushes foes away and interrupts them.
cards.efficiency: For expensive spells with many cards.
cards.precision: More critical hits from this spell.
cards.reflex: A defensive automatic: the spell fires by itself when you are struck.
cards.palm: A short, hard melee carrier that throws a foe back.
cards.chi: Armor-breaking force; as an Enchant, speed for the party.
cards.song: A Bard's Enchant: the effect becomes a party buff.
cards.sonic: Shock and weaken together; on a Song, a damage buff.
cards.crescendo: Damage and area in one card.
cards.earth: Roots and armor breaking; on an Enchant, a tougher party.
cards.keen: Crit chance and damage in one card.
cards.chrono: The strongest slow; on an Enchant, faster casting.
cards.loop: An Echo that costs cooldown instead of power.

panel.title: The idea
lines: You build your own skills from spell cards. A forged spell is an ordinary skill: it goes on your hotbar, ranks up with skill points and takes modifiers like any other.
Every SECTION of a spell needs one CARRIER card and one EFFECT card. MODIFIER cards are optional.

panel.title: The three card types
lines: CARRIER = how it is delivered. Missile flies to your aim, Area bursts around you, Strike falls from the sky, Slash is a weapon swing, Enchant blesses allies. The carrier sets the shape, range, base cost, cooldown and cast time.
EFFECT = what it does. Fire burns, Frost chills and freezes, Storm shocks, Venom poisons, Holy judges, Shadow weakens, Steel bleeds, Stone sunders, Life heals you.
MODIFIER = a change to that section: Damage, Expanse (area), Spray (more missiles), Haste, Efficiency, Echo, Time and so on.
Carriers come in three families. Spell carriers cost mana and use spell power. Martial carriers cost stamina and use your weapon's damage. Archery carriers do the same and need a bow.

panel.title: Copies stack
lines: Put the same card in a section more than once to boost it.
Each extra EFFECT copy: +{effectP}% damage and healing, statuses last {statusDurP}% longer.
Each extra CARRIER copy: bigger radius, faster missile, longer duration, longer range.
Each extra MODIFIER copy: its effect again.
You may hold {copiesBase} copies of one card per section, +1 every {copiesPer} levels.

panel.title: Power, cost and cooldown
lines: POWER: the carrier's base damage (spell carriers: a base plus your level, times your spell power; weapon carriers: a share of your weapon's damage), then x effect copies, x Damage cards, x +{rankP}% per skill rank past the first, x your skill damage bonuses.

COST: the carrier's mana or stamina cost. Every card in the section past the first two adds {costP}%. Efficiency cards cut it, Damage cards raise it. A second section adds {secCost2}% of its own cost, a third {secCost3}%.
COOLDOWN: the carrier's cooldown. A second section adds {secCd2}% of its own cooldown, a third {secCd3}%. Haste cards and your cooldown reduction shorten it.
The preview on the right of the window shows the finished numbers before you forge.

panel.title: Sections: chaining spells
lines: A spell can have up to three sections. Section II goes off where section I ends, section III where section II ends.
Missile (I) + Area (II) = a bolt that bursts where it lands: a fireball.
Only some carriers can be a later section: {chainCarriers}.
Section III opens at level {sec3Level}. Cards per spell: {slotsBase}, +1 every {slotsPer} levels, plus your class bonus; the amulet holds {maxSpells} spells.

panel.title: Lingering area spells (zones)
lines: Put a TIME card in the same section as an AREA carrier and the burst becomes a zone: a circle that stays on the ground.
A zone lasts {zoneDur} s (more Time cards: longer) and repeats its own hit every {zoneTick} s. Every section after it goes off again on each tick, from the zone's centre.
Mana is paid once, when you cast. Sections before the zone go off once.
Example: Missile + Fire (I), then Area + Fire + Time (II) = a firebolt that leaves a burning circle where it lands.

panel.title: A worked example: Frost Fireball
lines: 1. Click the first slot of section I and pick the Missile card. Pick Fire as its effect. You now have a Fire Missile: a firebolt.
2. In section II pick Area and Frost. The bolt now bursts into a frost nova where it lands: burning AND chilled foes.
3. Add a Damage card to section I: +25% damage for +10% cost. Add a second Frost to section II: the nova hits +{effectP}% harder.
4. Read the preview: damage, radius, mana and cooldown. Name it, press Forge, and it lands on a free hotbar key.
5. To change it later, open it from the list on the right. Dismantling a spell gives every card back.

panel.title: Getting cards
lines: Every hero starts with a kit for their class. More cards drop from monsters (bosses always), chests and elites.
The Spell tree (button at the top) spends its own points, one every few levels, on bonuses only crafted spells feel.
